note: Headless probe 2026-10-27: under claude -p or the Agent SDK, Claude Code rejects $.session.compact, so the mod logs a headless row per session id (via session-start, compact-rejected or same-load) and neither nudges nor arms a pre-idle turn. With compact: command it compacts by running /compact, and status says so; a row without the field, or a later one with compact: none (via command-failed: the /compact path went off), says automatic compaction is not available here. The pre-idle turn is off either way; a later session start row of the same session (an interactive load) clears both.
